top_signals.title: USMCA Critical 'Competitiveness Platform' to Compete with China, Says John Bozzella
top_signals.summary:
John Bozzella, president and CEO of Alliance for Automotive innovation, said that it is critical to have a trilateral trade agreement between the US, Canada and Mexico as a 'competitiveness platform' to compete with China in the automotive industry. Bozzella also discussed legislation to bar Chinese autos, saying that popular car company Mercedes would have to seek a waiver due to Chinese ownership stake. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: BMW Targets 8,000 More Job Cuts in Fresh Cost-Cutting Drive
top_signals.summary: BMW shares in Germany are down 36% so far this year, as the automaker's latest forecast downgrade was described by JPMorgan analyst Jose Asumendi as a "wake-up call for the auto industry." The outlook for BMW continues to deteriorate, with Bloomberg reporting that the automaker will begin a sweeping workforce restructuring in Germany this fall.
